images.caption: Figure 2:Overview ofMOTIVE.The backbone VLM evaluates each candidate answer using five Direct Verification Prompts (DVP-1–DVP-5) and aggregates their scores to guide an accept-or-rethink decision. Accepted answers are returned, while rethinking updates the interaction history and generates a revised candidate.

Figure 3:Effect of verification-view diversity.Accuracy (%) on five benchmarks as the number of distinct verification
prompts increases from one to five, while keeping five verification slots.
Figure 4:Effect of the verification loss weightλver\lambda_{\mathrm{ver}}.Accuracy (%) on five benchmarks under different values ofλver\lambda_{\mathrm{ver}}using Qwen2.5-VL-3B.
Figure 5:Effect of the aggregate-level verification loss weightβagg\beta_{\mathrm{agg}}.Accuracy (%) on five benchmarks under different values ofβagg\beta_{\mathrm{agg}}using Qwen2.5-VL-3B.
Figure 6:Effect of the calibration loss weightβcal\beta_{\mathrm{cal}}.Accuracy (%) on five benchmarks under different values ofβcal\beta_{\mathrm{cal}}using Qwen2.5-VL-3B.

Figure 7:Overview of the five Direct Verification Prompts (DVPs) used inMOTIVE. Each prompt evaluates the same candidate answer from a different
verification perspective and produces a binary YES/NO judgment.
Figure 8:Initial answer generation prompt.The prompt template used to generate the initial candidate answer for VLM inference.

Figure 9:Rethinking prompt.The prompt template used to trigger answer regeneration when the previous
response is considered unreliable by the verification process.
Figure 10:Effect of the acceptance thresholdτ\tau.Accuracy (%) on five benchmarks under different values ofτ\tauusing Qwen2.5-VL-3B.
Figure 11:Effect of computation-aware reward coefficientcc.Accuracy and rethinking turns are reported on five benchmarks using Qwen2.5-VL-3B.

Figure 13:Qualitative example of reliability-guided selective rethinking.The initial incorrect answer receives a low score and triggers rethinking, while the final visually grounded answer reaches the acceptance threshold and is returned.
